text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Rich impasto oil painting of a deserted interstellar harbor on a copper-green alien plateau, graceful grounded cargo spacecraft, monumental curved docking walls, terracotta planet low in the golden sky, visible palette-knife strokes and tactile layered paint, strong but harmonious teal-ochre composition, open landing apron.
